definition.phaseTransition: Fraction of on-target drugs with Phase k trials that also have at least one trial at Phase > k (drugs without advancement whose latest Phase-k trial started within 3 years are right-censored). Phase 3 → approval is not measurable from ClinicalTrials.gov.
definition.trialCompletion: COMPLETED / (COMPLETED + TERMINATED + WITHDRAWN + SUSPENDED), with separate combined-phase bucket, whyStopped classification (efficacy, safety, operational, unknown), excluding-operational completion rate, and UNKNOWN-status sensitivity rate.

disclaimer: Phase transition rate measures the fraction of on-target drugs in this class that advanced to a subsequent clinical phase (drugs whose most recent trial in that phase started within 3 years without advancing are right-censored); Phase 3 → approval cannot be measured from ClinicalTrials.gov. Trial completion rate is a secondary operational metric measuring COMPLETED / (COMPLETED + TERMINATED + WITHDRAWN + SUSPENDED) — finishing a trial without early termination does not imply meeting efficacy endpoints or regulatory approval.
